observed_gate_scope: Matched instrumented original n1 x5 and candidate n6 x5; no statistical confidence or global maximum-concurrency claim.
boundary: Native api_request event before wrapped generator invocation, including native logging/SDK preparation. Not HTTP arrival. Warm candidate request boundary is an interval inferred from turn start and a source-proven model message.
privacy: Only variant/repeat/index/phase, timings, counters, booleans, model configuration and source hashes. No prompts, outputs, tool arguments, credentials, native session/request IDs or local account paths.

clock_verification.assumption: No unobserved realtime clock excursion between bracketing samples; native timestamps are millisecond quantized.
clock_verification.sample_count_note: sample_count counts clock metadata records, including copies in events exported in the same batch; distinct_clock_samples deduplicates those observations.

thresholds.interval_pass_rule: candidate upper quantile / baseline lower quantile <= threshold; quantiles formed from individual turn intervals

historical_evidence_preserved.interpretation: Earlier larger-concurrency failed trial remains separate.
Earlier whole-turn pass with stricter post-first-tool failure remains separate; no verdict overwritten.
Two native request records were both cold main/auto-memory, not cold/warm; initial failed assumption retained.
First native profile initialized extension state and correctly restarted; failed retained-process expectation preserved.
Follow-up retained official process with real local tools validated repeated native request pairing and warm exporter absence.

limitations: Native telemetry introduces overhead; both variants used identical telemetry configuration and unchanged direct model routes. These matched observations do not retroactively validate prior uninstrumented trials.

Official Qwen0.23.1 shuts its telemetry SDK after the first persistent turn. All30 candidate warm samples are conservative intervals, not exact request-time observations; their unobserved request counts are not zero.
A symmetric±1ms native timestamp envelope plus observed clock-offset uncertainty is included. No unobserved realtime clock excursion between samples is assumed.
All180 observed native attempts are checked; completion tails are retained. No observed completion was even possibly post-result under the uncertainty envelope.
Five original serial pairs and30 candidate pairs provide operational p50/p95 checks only. Cloud/model variability and telemetry overhead remain; this does not establish maximum supported concurrency.
